label: Guide me: Compute & close

params.name: lede
params.default: Turn the mapped books and 26AS into the return in {product}: the computation, interest, the filing files in the department's own format, sign-off, filing and revisions.
params.label: lede

default.title: Where the year stands
default.say: The strip: mapped, reconciled, computed, signed off, filed, closed.

default.title: The computation
default.say: Each head adds its mapped rows; house property gets its 30%. Pick the regime here.

default.title: Interest, worked out
default.say: 234A, 234B and 234C come from the 26AS challans by date; a senior citizen with no business income pays no advance-tax interest. Type a figure only to override.

default.title: Refund interest
default.say: On a refund, 244A interest at half a percent a month - none when the refund is under 10% of the tax.

default.title: Files in the department's format
default.say: The ITR JSON and, for an audit, the Form 3CB-3CD JSON - each checked against the CBDT schema before you download, with what is still missing listed. The balance sheet tallies and the P&L profit matches business income.

default.title: Sign off and file
default.say: A reviewer signs off; then the acknowledgement number and date filed. The return type - original, belated, revised or ITR-U - follows from the dates.

default.title: Revise or undo
default.say: Start a revised return, or an ITR-U after 31 December with its 140B additional tax; discard a revision; or undo a wrong 'filed' with a reason. Nothing filed is ever deleted.

description_nl: 2026-10-04: the Compute & close walk, up to date with the screen; tours/sf-compute.json is made from it.
